blocks.text: But, because the Greeks upon one occasion also approached His Disciples, desiring to see Him,—it is written, that, when they had told Him this, He said: “The hour is come, that the Son of Man should be glorified. I say unto you, that unless the grain of wheat fall into the earth and die, it will remain alone; but if it (so) die, it will bring forth much fruit.” By these things also, He obviously declared in a mystery, that, among the Greeks, among foreign nations and the children of a different generation, those things which comprehended the praises of His Godhead should be embraced.
